Class MockVirtualController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.network.MockVirtualController
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualController, Remote
public class MockVirtualController extends Object implements VirtualController
The VirtualController interface defines the remote methods available for the controller in the Galaxy Trucker game. These methods are invoked by the client to perform game actions such as logging in, creating and joining games, managing tiles, handling cards, and interacting with game objects.

This interface is designed to be used in a distributed setting where clients interact with a server via Remote Method Invocation (RMI). The methods cover various aspects of game management, including player actions, tile manipulations, and interaction with game elements like cargo holds, crew, and dice rolls.
